intro: Kyrgyzstan has about 7 million people, most of them Kyrgyz.

chapters.title: People
text: Kyrgyz make up about three-quarters, with Uzbeks in the south and Russians in the north. Kyrgyz and Russian are both official. Most people are Sunni Muslim.

chapters.title: Life
text: Bishkek is the capital. In summer, herders still take animals up to the jailoos and live in yurts.
